title: Child circuit size bounded by parent
statement: Let $g$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables that is a single gate — an AND or OR gate applied to a list of child circuits — and let $c$ be one of those children. If the size of $g$ (its total number of gate and literal nodes) is at most $s$, then the size of $c$ is at most $s - 1$.
hypotheses_covered: g is a gate node (AND or OR) with a given list of children
c is a child in that list
the size of the node is at most s
replaced:
If a node circuit $\mathrm{node}\,\mathit{isAnd}\,cs$ has size at most $s$, then every
child $c \in cs$ has size at most $s - 1$.
